Strategy: Size-conditioned fit choice. When the item is at most a quarter of the largest feasible residual, place it in the roomiest bin to preserve tight bins for large items; otherwise rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit exactly for small items when a roomier bin exists. It may help by saving tight slots for items that need them, but may fail if the roomiest bin was the only one able to hold a later large item.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [r if item * 4 <= max(bins) else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Size-conditioned fit: small items (<= max residual/4) go to roomiest bin, else Best Fit.
